benchmarks.note: undirected cycle C_n, connectivity 2; every non-adjacent vertex pair is a minimum separator so the output grows ~n^2/2 while the Kanevsky loop runs O(k.n) max-flows on the Even-Tarjan reduction plus an all_st_mincuts enumeration per non-neighbour. Cost is dominated by the per-pair min-cut enumeration, which grows super-linearly (~13x per doubling of n)

m x m square lattice (16/36/64 vertices), connectivity 2 with a denser, more clustered flow structure than the cycle; stresses the reduction + relabel + all_st_mincuts pipeline on a graph where each interior vertex has degree 4. Similar super-linear growth driven by the per-non-neighbour max-flow / mincut enumeration
